# HandleQuerySize

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Reads the size in bytes of a memory object.

!!! info "Library helper"
    Implemented in `zuzu.h` on top of the syscalls; it has no syscall number of its own.

```c
Err HandleQuerySize(Handle h, size_t *out);
```

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `h` | in | Memory object handle. |
| `out` | out | Receives the size on success; may be NULL. |

## Returns

As HandleQueryAt() with QUERY_SIZE.
